use_RuntimeInfoHook_before_run: use RuntimeInfoHook before_run to update metainfo with cfg, seed, experiment name, and mmengine version into the message hub
use_RuntimeInfoHook_before_train: use RuntimeInfoHook before_train to update loop stage, epoch, iter, max epochs, and max iters into the message hub
use_RuntimeInfoHook_before_train_iter: use RuntimeInfoHook before_train_iter to update current iteration count and learning rate values into the message hub
use_RuntimeInfoHook_after_train_iter: use RuntimeInfoHook after_train_iter to log model output variables as scalars into the message hub each iteration
use_is_scalar: use _is_scalar to check whether a value is a scalar type including numpy arrays, Python numbers, or single element tensors
